#### Data Loading

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(arrow)
library(anndataR)

# Establishes minimum gene counts. Thresholds sourced from original preprint.
min_counts <- c(SLV11 = 150, SLV12 = 50,  SLV13 = 50,  SLV14 = 50,
                SLV15 = 50,  SLV16 = 150, SLV17 = 50,  SLV18 = 150)

# Defines function to run through all samples and perform quality control + export.
qc_sample <- function(sample_id, min_count, data_root = "/Users/evangrosso/Desktop/Gut GVHD Pilot/data") {
  
  # Defines file directories
  matrix_dir <- file.path(data_root, sample_id, "binned_outputs", "square_016um", "filtered_feature_bc_matrix")
  spatial_dir <- file.path(data_root, sample_id, "binned_outputs", "square_016um", "spatial")
  
  # Creates Seurat Object from original data
  obj <- CreateSeuratObject(Read10X(data.dir = matrix_dir), assay = "Spatial", project = sample_id)
  
  # Subsets data according to minimum gene count thresholds
  obj <- subset(obj, subset = nCount_Spatial >= min_count)
  
  # Subsets data according to maximum percent.mt (20%) sourced from original preprint
  obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(obj, pattern = "^MT-")
  obj <- subset(obj, subset = percent.mt < 20)
  
  # Reads spatial data
  positions <- read_parquet(file.path(spatial_dir, "tissue_positions.parquet"))
  pos <- positions[match(Cells(obj), positions$barcode), ]
  spatial_coords <- as.matrix(pos[, c("pxl_col_in_fullres", "pxl_row_in_fullres")])
  storage.mode(spatial_coords) <- "double"
  
  # Convert to AnnData
  adata <- as_AnnData(
    obj, 
    assay_name = "Spatial", 
    x_mapping = "counts",
    layers_mapping = FALSE, 
    obs_mapping = TRUE, 
    var_mapping = FALSE,
    obsm_mapping = FALSE, 
    obsp_mapping = FALSE, 
    uns_mapping = FALSE
  )
  
  adata$obsm <- list(spatial = spatial_coords)
  
  # Save file
  out_path <- file.path(data_root, paste0(tolower(sample_id), ".h5ad"))
  adata$write_h5ad(out_path)
  }

# Loop through all functions and perform QC function
for (s in names(min_counts)) {
  qc_sample(s, min_counts[[s]])
}
```
